chains.name: gen0
chains.description: Generation 0 from the Etna start S = 0 with L = 7: genesis at 0, every single-height increment through 48, and switches at S(1)..S(7) that add (6), remove (13), re-weight (20), add, remove and re-weight at once (27), add (34), replace the largest member (41) and re-weight (48). Equal powers order by address; ties go to the lower address.

chains.name: gen1
chains.description: Generation 1 from governance recovery at c = 48 (8.4): a new genesis at 48 with a different committee and initial height 49. Generation 0's update returned at S(7) = 48 is discarded with the rest of its state; the next switch is S(8) = 55 (add one member, remove another), active from H(8) = 57.

chains.name: bounds_a
chains.description: L = 3. At S(1) = 2 the update leaves a priority spread of exactly 2·total, so neither UpdateWithChangeSet nor IncrementProposerPriority rescales; the increment raises it to 2·total + 1, so height 3 rescales by 2 and then centers a sum of -1 by floor(-1 / 4) = -1, leaving the largest residual sum, n - 1.

chains.name: bounds_b
chains.description: L = 3. Height 3 rescales a spread of 2·total + 1 left by the switch at S(1) = 2; the switch at S(2) = 5 leaves a spread of 2·total + 1 inside UpdateWithChangeSet, whose rescale truncates negative priorities toward zero.

chains.name: bounds_c
chains.description: L = 3. Three members of equal power: genesis and later increments break priority ties by address. Height 3 has no update and increments a set whose spread is exactly 2·total, which is not rescaled.

max_committee.description: 4096 members (n_max's bound) at CometBFT's MaxTotalVotingPower: genesis at 0 and one increment. Member i (0 <= i < 4096) is key mi with private key 0x10000 + i; its power is 2^48 + (i mod 64) - 32 for i < 4095, and member 4095 takes the rest of the total, 2^48 + 2078. Only the hash and the first and last rows of each set are listed.
